args.message: S1 (Rack A inlet) stuck at 27.19C for ~28 min, flat-suspect. Other sensors nominal, diagnose p_fault 0.185 (none 0.815). No hazard suspected. Needs sensor check/recalibration (215 days since cal).

data.text:
Trigger is benign - stuck sensor, not a room hazard:

- S1 (Rack A inlet) frozen at 27.19°C for ~28 min, std 0 for 20 min, flagged flat-suspect. Untrusted, excluded from diagnosis.
- Trusted sensors normal: S2 ~25.8°C, S3 ~23.2°C, M1 ~4.5 kW all flat trends ~0; M2 voltage drop noisy ~60-90 mV with no rising trend.
- Physics diagnosis: no-fault 0.815, total fault only 0.185, breach risk in 90 min 0.02.
- Hidden-zone regression (imperfect, S1 excluded): rack B 29.3±2°C margin 5.7°C, desk2 margin 5.6°C, connector margin 39.5°C - no plausible breach.

No action requested. Info alert sent for S1 maintenance/recalibration. Recommend human check of S1 wiring/sensor, no cooling or power action needed.
